programs.title: Ukiyoe Edo-life
programs.desc: . A full moon shines above a bustling neighborhood. Featured prominently are kabuki theaters...on hiatus. Still, people have come out to take in the nightlife, and hopefully a celebrity sighting or two.

programs.title: Medical Frontiers
programs.desc: . Age-related hearing loss is a risk factor for dementia, according to a report in the Lancet. In Japan, a unique rehabilitation program is helping people recognize words while wearing hearing aids. Erica Angyal, Maxwell Powers.

programs.title: Outside in Lost in Academia
programs.desc: . Japanese culture is in the global spotlight like never before. Dive into the work of international scholars exploring Japan in bold, original ways, uncovering unique perspectives and deep insights.
